parsed.post: Discarding my latest run (1.002) because it used TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', which contains the evaluation shard 10, causing data leakage. Reverting to my clean best (0.899 is also contaminated, so I'll revert to my last valid non-leaky state). Next, I will pivot to a clean DEPTH=8 run with TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9'.
parsed.description: Switching to DEPTH=8 on clean shards (0-9) to test capacity without data leakage.
